name: sm-rank-collect (webhook, SM-15 batch 1) -- BLOCKED, see meta

meta.description: AUTHORED BUT NOT RUNNABLE TODAY -- do not activate. The Standard-queue completion seam design doc §10 names 'sm-rank-collect': a DataForSEO postback carries a TASK ID ONLY (dataforseo.ts's own header comment) and n8n is meant to relay it into the platform's authoritative fetch. The receiver below (secret check + at-least-once dedupe on taskId) IS real and independently testable. What it forwards to is NOT: (1) there is no mcp-hub tool bound to the real, landed controller route 'POST /api/:tenantId/modules/search/rank-pulls/callback' -- design doc §10 names the intended tool 'search.ingestRankResults' but it does not exist anywhere in modules/search/index.ts's mcpTools (not even as an unregistered stub, unlike search.keywordResearch/search.runAudit) -- confirmed against the live /mcp/tool-defs 2026-07-30. (2) Even if that tool existed, the real callback route needs {engagementId, propertyId, keywordId, taskId} -- far more context than a genuine DataForSEO postback would ever carry (it only echoes the task id, plus whatever 'tag' string was set at task_post time). Correlating a bare task id back to (engagement, property, keyword) is unsolved anywhere in the platform today -- it needs either a task-id-keyed lookup this ticket has no tool to query, or a tag-encoding scheme set at task_post time in providers/dataforseo.ts, which is out of this ticket's file ownership (providers/* is under concurrent QA audit per the SM-15 brief) and is itself a contract question, not a one-line fix. Reported, not invented. NO safety-poll half is built either (design doc's own '+ safety poll'): there is no tool to enumerate provider_calls stuck at status='posted', and blindly polling would be exactly the aggressive-retry-on-a-paid-op pattern SM-50 warns against -- building one without an enumeration surface would mean guessing at a poll target, which risks re-charging DataForSEO for no reason. DO NOT import/activate until the tool + correlation gap above is resolved by whoever owns modules/search/index.ts and providers/dataforseo.ts next.
